name: Protopasta Carbon Fiber PLA
filament_notes:
15% (by weight) chopped carbon fiber in PLA or HTPLA; covers Carbon Fiber PLA, Carbon Fiber HTPLA and Recycled Carbon Fiber PLA.
FAQ: 195-220C. TDS: 205C, 60C bed. Material Data Table: 220C up to 6 mm3/s, 240C up to 12 mm3/s, 55C plate. This profile uses 210C with a 12 mm3/s cap - raise the temperature when printing near the cap.
Abrasive: Proto-Pasta recommends a hard steel nozzle and gears, and replacing PTFE tubing more often. They report good results with a 0.5 mm nozzle and a spring-loaded direct-drive extruder. Brittle as filament - avoid sharp bends. Density: TDS and FAQ say 1.3 g/cm3 (used here); the SDS says 1.15.
